Up to five may attack one target.
Perception + Awareness vs. Dex + Stealth to detect. If sprung: Wits + Awareness to act — fail = no action; 1–2 = move/dodge/parry only; ≥3 = no effect.
Diff. 3 (melee) or 5 (ranged). Target holds on with Wits + combat (attack successes).
All damage penetrating soak treated as a success. No ping damage.

Str or Dex + Brawl or Martial Arts attack. Attacker may do bashing damage of Str+2. Defender uses standard defenses or own clinch test. On later turns, opposed test on highest tick; winner controls clinch to damage, escape or hold.
−1 attack success; (Str)B damage. Target rolls Dex + Athletics (2) to avoid knockdown.
−1 attack success; (Str)B damage. Target at −2 dice next turn. Both roll Stamina + Athletics (3) or suffer knockdown.

Sta + Resistance (virulence) to avoid contracting. Intelligence + Medicine to treat. Sta + Endurance (morbidity) to survive.
Stamina + Endurance hours of labor without penalty, then −1 die per hour. Negate with Stamina + Endurance for up to Sta + Endurance days.

Stamina + Resistance × 30 seconds; each success on Stamina + Resistance adds +30 seconds.

Intelligence + Lore provides extra dice for summoning or banishment.
Automatically know when inside a manse or demesne; more detail with Perception + Occult.
1B per two feet over 50 feet. Falls over 50 feet, or onto dangerous ground, become lethal. Wits + Athletics may improve the situation.

Perception + Bureaucracy. A fast-talker opposes with Charisma + Bureaucracy; a fraud opposes with Wits + Larceny.
Extended opposed Wits + Bureaucracy until one party buys. Every five accumulated successes halves or doubles the price.

Extended Int + Linguistics, difficulty equal to the strength of the code or obscurity of the language.
Intelligence + Sail. Handling in tight waters is Wits + Sail to track correctly, then Dex + Sail.

Stamina + Sail each day to avoid.
Perception + Socialize (situation). Extra successes give a clearer picture.
Perception + Socialize to find good allies; extended Charisma + Presence to become friends.

tables.title: Regaining Health
tables.note: Aggravated levels heal as lethal but may not be healed magically. Ref 234 & 149.

tables.title: Wounds
rows: Bashing damage filling the Incapacitated level.
Lethal or aggravated damage filling Incapacitated. Dies in Stamina turns (minus extra health levels). Healed only by magic; cannot act unless immune to wound penalties.

Wounds over one HL bleed, losing an additional HL every several minutes. Exalts stop the flow with Stamina (1) or by tending; mortals stop if treated with Wits + Medicine (HL of largest wound), and wounds may reopen with activity.

Stamina + Resistance (3+) to avoid when taking lethal damage or exposing a wound (wound penalties don't apply); Exalts −2 diff. An infected exalt rolls Sta + Endurance (1) each morning or suffers −2 dice all day. Mortals' difficulty rises by one each day; on a botch or when diff exceeds Sta + Endurance, the mortal dies in Stamina days unless magically healed.
Mortals taking wounds over 3HL must be treated surgically or the penalty becomes permanent. Reduced to −4 or incapacitated, a mortal may lose a limb.
Useless arm: −2 dice for Athletics. Useless leg: half movement and −3 Athletics.
